answer: In an agent market brokering timber and basalt freight, clustered keys can be made to share punishment. At each hourly beacon pulse, auditors compare every key's order timing and payout wallets; keys whose activity moves together above 0.9 correlation are grouped. If any member is caught faking a delivery, every key in the group loses 10 credits times the group size, so 100 linked fakes lose 100,000 credits from one catch, while a lone honest broker risks only 10. Splitting into uncorrelated keys means running each one separately. Limit: real teams must register as one entity.
